FIELDS.NAME: Bargain Bazaar
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Bargain Bazaar operates as a discount department store, offering a wide range of products including clothing, home goods, electronics, and seasonal items at competitive prices. Our core operations are focused on providing customers with quality merchandise while maintaining a strong emphasis on customer service and satisfaction. We prioritize a well-organized retail environment and efficient inventory management systems to ensure that our product offerings are readily available and appealing to shoppers. Bargain Bazaar operates in a suburban shopping center, benefiting from established customer traffic and has a history of complying with local, state, and federal retail regulations. Our team is committed to minimizing shrinkage through documented loss prevention protocols and employee training programs focused on safety and customer service. We do not engage in food preparation or cooking activities on our premises, ensuring that we maintain a low risk environment. Additionally, we restrict our incidental repair operations to well within acceptable limits, maintaining a primary focus on retail sales.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Four incidents of retail theft reported between 01/2022 and 10/2023, totaling $2,500. All incidents were reported to local authorities and resolved. Currently, we have enhanced security measures in place to mitigate future risks.
FIELDS.ADDRESS: 456 Discount Dr, Shopping Plaza, Suburbia, ST 12345-6789
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B Vault, Grade III, UL Listed
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central station alarm system with a dedicated security team on-site during business hours and regular patrols around the premises.
